notes: Loose public materials and fixed features added in seed 5. Add more here to experiment: every entry needs an id, name, open cell (x, y), mass_kg, materials, description and flags. Items heavier than 20 kg cannot be carried. Run tools/generate_material_art.py afterwards to paint them. Optional fields: owner_id (an NPC id; others' property can still be used, and it is recorded), since_seed (added in that world seed, so older journeys replay unchanged), water_l (a fixed water source such as a trough). feature 'fire' with burning true: a lasting heat source (seed 8). no_sprite: part of a building's art. installed_in: a fixture it starts fitted into (seed 9: the cracked bar across the gate). Seed 11 (D-51): the old wainwright's yard in the bottom-right corner, 48 free materials (metals, stone, wood, hide, cord, bone, glue) for experimenting with weapons and armour.
